pairs.subject: embedded-db
pairs.evidence: packages/ui/src/storage/trouble.ts:11 The context's only persistence is a key-value adapter over a localStorage-like `StorageLike` (getItem/setItem/removeItem), so there is no embedded engine whose pool, journal, maintenance, extensions or file the code operates; a search of keymap/, layers/, storage/, window/ and freshness/ for sqlite, pragma, vacuum, journal_mode and wal_checkpoint found nothing, and the one IndexedDB mention (trouble.ts:10) is a comment recording that IndexedDB was dropped.

techniques.evidence: packages/ui/src/storage/store.ts:39 The backing is a synchronous Web Storage object with no connections, so there is nothing to pool.
packages/ui/src/storage/store.ts:27 Here corruption means a key whose JSON fails its schema, not a malformed database file, so the engine-level corruption classes have nothing to apply to.
packages/ui/src/storage/trouble.ts:16 The only failure classes are browser quota, unavailability and refusal. No journal or sync mode can be configured.
